title: An invitation email shows as a native card (fake data)
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeData; open the 'Invitation: … review' conversation in Work's Inbox
Read the card, then click Show original, then Show invitation
expected: A card replaces the sender's email: YES MAYBE NO, the title, When in your time zone, Where (a link), Who (organizer first, you as Me), About and Join with Google Meet; no invite.ics tile. Show original brings the email and its tile back. Without a connected calendar YES says 'Connect calendar to respond' and the conversation stays in the Inbox.
